question: Colon cancer, EXCEPT
question_ar: كل ما يلي صحيح فيما يتعلق بسرطان القولون باستثناء؟

options.text: It's the second most common cause of cancer related death in Jordan
A ( T1 N1 MO stage 3) tumor is equivalent to Duke stage C tumor
A majority of colorectal cancers occur in the descending colon
FAP and HNPCC are two inherited causes of colorectal cancer
Patients with ulcerative colitis have increased risk of developing colon cancer

correct_text: A majority of colorectal cancers occur in the descending colon
